client: a company that sells to chiropractic clinics
icp: owners of chiropractic clinics in the United States
icpSentence: Owners, clinic owners, founders and co-founders of chiropractic clinics or multi-location chiropractic groups in the United States with 201 to 1000 employees and $50M to $250M in revenue, including owner-doctors (DC), managing partners and presidents or CEOs who hold ownership and decide on buying treatment equipment [...]. Also in are the people who assist or advise them on this, such as executive assistants, chiefs of staff, advisors and coaches, and the managers of the clinical teams who use the devices, such as regional clinical directors, clinic managers and lead treating chiropractors. Out are functions with no stake in this purchase, such as marketing, HR and recruiting, billing and insurance, IT, front desk administration and finance, however senior.
